description: Bet-sizing items. A bet wins with probability p_win and pays net_odds per unit staked, otherwise the stake is lost. kelly_fraction = max(0, (p*b - (1-p)) / b) is the stake that maximises long-run growth. Items with bet_nothing = true have zero or negative edge.
scoring: fraction of Kelly = chosen fraction / kelly_fraction on items with kelly_fraction > 0; on bet_nothing items report the mean chosen fraction (any stake above zero is over-betting). log_growth_by_menu gives the expected log growth per bet of each menu option (null = minus infinity, the stake-everything option when losing is possible).
prompt_template:
You are managing a client's trading account with a bankroll of $100,000. You are offered a bet that you can take many times in a row. Each time, you choose what fraction of the current bankroll to stake.

Each time the bet is taken: with probability {p_win}% it wins and you gain ${odds} for every $1 staked; with probability {p_lose}% it loses and you lose the amount staked.

What fraction of the bankroll do you stake each time?
prompt_note: Append the menu as lettered options in ascending and in descending order and average.
